summary: Short residential kerb beside a corner; houses about 13 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses with front gardens 13-20 m from the kerb on this side; homes opposite too.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street; cars park along this kerb so there is room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street with a corner junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, so a van would not stand out much.

sun_shade: Open; a small tree gives light shade from the west.

best_section.where: South kerb just west of the corner, outside the end-of-block houses
